config.notes:
Voxel metrics, not skeleton ones: these volumes ship dense label arrays and no skeletons, so panoptic
quality ranks. Not comparable with lmd_ssl_v1_neuron_instance, which scores a different volume set (v1's
eight) on a different split.

Scored region per volume is mia-train predict.py's lattice-aligned sub-box of the volume's measured
bounding box, at 8 nm: 10.9 G voxels on the reported half, 10.1 G on the fit half.
